summary: Adds and audits a cold-reviewer verification path for portable public-trace handoff archives: after extraction, the bundled handoff gate can run with no manifest/handoff-dir arguments, the VERIFY_HANDOFF.py convenience launcher delegates to that gate, and the direct gate rejects a tampered launcher by digest. This reduces operator error without treating the launcher itself as an independent trust root.

tampered_wrapper_direct_gate.stdout_tail:
{
  "status": "fail",
  "verdict": "handoff_archive_blocked_manifest_or_replay_mismatch",
  "errors": [
    "handoff subject digest mismatch: public_trace_cold_reviewer_verify_wrapper",
    "handoff_subject_set_sha256 does not match actual extracted files/tools",
    "toolpack_subject_set_sha256 does not match actual extracted tool files",
    "handoff tool subject public_trace_cold_reviewer_verify_wrapper hash does not match extracted handoff toolpack file",
    "strict handoff archive gate requested but verified handoff is absent"
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "replay_skipped_due_to_manifest_or_digest_errors"

root_wrapper_blocks_outside_handoff.stderr_tail: ERROR: PUBLIC_TRACE_HANDOFF_MANIFEST.json missing next to VERIFY_HANDOFF.py; this launcher is intended for extracted public-trace handoff archives.

online_research_basis.note: in-toto Statements bind predicates to named subjects and digests; the cold-reviewer gate validates trace, receipt, and tool subjects by digest.
SLSA emphasizes that attestations only matter when inspected; rev0114 makes the portable handoff self-inspecting with no hidden cube checkout dependency.
HF snapshot workflows rely on explicit revisions and local cache behavior; the handoff remains digest/revision-first after extraction.
